title: Distributions or Quantiles? A Convex Variational Theory of Worst-Case Risk
abstract: arXiv:2610.29652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Worst-case risk evaluation is central to finance and operations research, yet existing analytical results remain fragmented and largely confined to ambiguity sets with specific structures. Using spectral risk measures as the underlying class, we develop a convex variational theory that unifies these analyses and extends them to richer ambiguity models. The theory rests on a representation principle: use the quantile or distribution formulation that preserves convexity of the full ambiguity set. In both representations, the resulting optimality conditions provide a systematic route to identify the worst-case law and determine its risk value. translated_title: 分布还是分位数？最坏情况风险的凸变分理论
translated_abstract: 最坏情况风险评估是金融与运筹学的核心问题，然而现有的解析结果仍然零散，且大多局限于具有特定结构的不确定性集合。本文以谱风险度量作为基础类，发展了一种凸变分理论，统一了这些分析并将其扩展到更丰富的不确定性模型。该理论建立在一个表示原理之上：采用能够保持完整不确定性集合凸性的分位数或分布表述。在这两种表述下，由此得到的最优性条件为识别最坏情况分布并确定其风险值提供了系统化的途径。该方法重现了经典的中心矩界，并为涉及尾部压力Wasserstein不确定性、双侧预期短缺（ES）区间、非对称部分矩、几何矩界以及指数-（原文此处截断）等实际驱动模型提供了闭式或半闭式解。
tldr: 本文以谱风险度量为基础，提出基于保持凸性的分布/分位数表示的凸变分理论，通过最优性条件系统化地统一并扩展了最坏情况风险分析，为多种不确定性集合模型给出闭式或半闭式的最坏情况分布及风险值。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a convex variational theory of worst-case risk built on spectral risk measures and convexity-preserving distribution/quantile representations, whose optimality conditions systematically identify worst-case laws and yield closed-form or semi-closed-form risk bounds across richer ambiguity models.
